m: dūram (am), ind. far, far from (gen. or abl. Pāṇ. ii, 3, 34, Kāś.), a long way off or a long period back, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. &c. (also dūrād dūram, AV. xii, 2, 14)
far above (ut-patati, Hit. i, 101/102) or below (ambhasi, Kathās. x, 29)
far i.e. much, in a high degree (dūram un-manī-kṛta, Prab. iii, 21/22)
dūraṃ-√ kṛ, to surpass, exceed, Ragh. xvii, 18
˚ṃ-karaṇa mf(ī)n. making far or distant, removing, Vop. (v.l.)
˚ṃ-gama mfn. going far away, VS. xxxiv, 1
